note: Machine-usable stat effects of every Forge race's four racials, read strictly from tooltip text. Values appear only where the text states the number.

Orc.tip: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec. Read from the demo.

Orc.summary: Curse & Bane immunity, -15% magic damage taken
Orc.tip: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Removes and grants immunity to all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 15% for 8 sec. Read from the demo.
+1% critical strike chance with all spells and abilities while an axe or two-handed axe is equipped. Read from the demo.

Undead.tip: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (No longer an immunity.) From the BlizzCon Deep Dive slide.

5 yd, 2 min cooldown. Regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec from a Humanoid or Undead corpse; moving, acting or taking damage cancels it. From the Deep Dive slide.

Undead.summary: 5% chance to drain up to 5% HP
Undead.tip: Your spells and attacks have a 5% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health. From the Deep Dive slide.

Tauren.tip: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec. Read from the demo.

Tauren.summary: Speed builds while you keep moving (no number shown)
Tauren.tip: Gain increased movement speed the longer you keep moving.

Troll.tip: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 10 sec. Read from the demo.
Channeled, 3 min cooldown. Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec; any movement, action or damage taken cancels it. Read from the demo.
10% of Health regen continues in combat.

Skyborne (Windshaper).tip: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel. Read from the demo.
0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Draw power from a convergence of elements: +10% movement and mounted speed for 30 sec, or 15 min if a convergence is nearby. Read from the demo.
Passive. 1% increased melee, ranged, and spellcasting Haste.
Passive. Damage to Elementals increased by 5%.

Human.tip: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Stun effects. Read from the demo.
Instant, 3 min cooldown. Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec. Read from the demo.
Passive. +2% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, auto attacks included, while you have a sword or two-handed sword equipped. Read off Soda's Warrior tooltip.

Dwarf.tip: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec. From the Deep Dive slide.
Sense nearby treasure and show it on the minimap. Lasts until cancelled.
+1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks while a mace or two-handed mace is equipped.

Night Elf.tip: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec. Read from the demo.

Instant, 10 sec cooldown. Slip into the shadows until you move; Night Elf Rogues and Druids stealth as if 1 level higher. Usable in combat: enemies are discouraged from attacking you, but the cooldown becomes 2 min. Read from the demo.

Gnome.tip: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Escape any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to them for 3 sec. Read from the demo.
Instant, 2 min cooldown. Your next 3 damaging or healing abilities cost 50% less Mana and do 10% more damage or healing. Read from the demo; a Warlock's tooltip only lists the damage half.

Skyborne (High Order).tip: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel. Read from the demo.
2 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Tap a nearby ley line for +100% Health and Mana regeneration: 15 sec if no ley line is nearby, 15 min if one is found. Read from the demo.
Passive. 1% increased melee, ranged, and spellcasting Haste.
Passive. Damage to Elementals increased by 5%.
